description.en: Same as AddParty_Message_Back, but without fading/stopping the current BGM (passes -1 for both the fade and wait durations).
Param ID of the character to add back to the party.
Whether to lock the member's position slot.
Whether to enable the member's avatar.
Whether to lock the member's avatar.
Optional level to set for the member (defaults to -1, meaning don't change it).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Bring a party member back with the "rejoined" presentation, without fading the BGM
AddParty_Message_NoFadeBGM_Back("para_cp0015", true, false, false, 18);
